originality.rationale: Scoped to all-parameter detuned reset-enhanced stationary fluorescence phase transition and exact drive-independent optimum with sharp gain ceiling. Full relevant resonant external resetting study Perfetto et al (2021) and detuned unreset Reynaud (2022), plus generalized reset framework Carollo et al (2023), were compared; their inspected statements do not supply this explicit complete classification. residual_risks: Standard detuned optical Bloch and pure-dephasing results may be rearranged to give the same condition; explicit prior all-parameter results were not exhaustively excluded.
General renewal or reset resolvent frameworks could have stronger coverage than sections inspected; publication priority should be independently checked.
General quantum resetting spectral paper (2018) only accessible as abstract; its full text was not inspected.
The resetting mechanism is idealized and ignores implementation costs, nonradiative channels and imperfect instantaneous preparation.

value.rationale: Addresses a clear physical control question in resonance fluorescence: when an apparently emission-suppressing ground reset becomes beneficial upon detuning, its unique optimum and the best possible uniform enhancement factor. Proves a global phase boundary and parameter-independent optimizer, rather than arbitrary slice or routine special value; significance does not presume practical experiment benefit.
